One sunny morning, a small brown puppy named Max wandered away from his home. He sniffed flowers and chased butterflies until he was lost. A kind girl named Lily found Max and saw his collar. She walked him all the way back home. Max was so happy to see his family again!

Barnaby was a little bear who dreamed of exploring space. He built a rocket out of cardboard boxes and silver tape in his bedroom. With a shiny colander on his head, Barnaby blasted off to the moon and made friends with glowing space bunnies.

Emma discovered a tiny door in her backyard fence. She opened it and found a magical garden with talking flowers. The roses told jokes and the sunflowers sang songs. Emma visited every day after school. The garden became her special secret place.
